minutes.headline: ZBA granted two special permits: a side-setback garage on Lancaster Ave and a permanent dining building at Il Forno.
minutes.summary: The Zoning Board of Appeals held two special permit hearings. The board heard a side-setback garage request at 1390 Lancaster Avenue and a request to replace a seasonal tent with a permanent dining structure at 494 Electric Avenue. The chair announced both permits granted; the roll-call tallies are not clear in the captions.

what_happened.line: The Zoning Board of Appeals chair stated that a special permit was granted for a new restaurant dining building at 494 Electric Avenue, after a roll call.
The permit is subject to site plan review by the planning board and a finding that it is not substantially more detrimental than the existing non-conforming use.
The chair stated that a special permit was granted for a detached garage with side-setback relief at 1390 Lancaster Avenue, with standard conditions read, including a two-year lapse.
The roll-call tallies for both permits are not clear in the captions, so the vote counts are not established here.
The applicant's attorney is to email proposed language tying an earlier special permit's clause to the prior owner; no vote was taken on it.

why_it_matters: The Electric Avenue permit replaces a seasonal tent with a permanent building on a non-conforming restaurant site, which changes what the property is and what it can add to the commercial tax base.
Residents at the hearing cited meals tax and property tax revenue in support, but the minutes record those as comments and give no figure for what the building would add.
watch_next: Planning board site plan review of the Electric Avenue dining building, which the permit makes a condition.
The attorney's proposed language on the earlier permit's prior-owner clause, which was to be emailed after the meeting.
